claims.claim: The asset matches the requested fixture, dimensions, parts and target names.
claims.evidence: asset/model.urdf, asset/asset.json and readings.json declare two_layer_supporter as a fixture with a single base link, two feet, two side posts, a back plate and shelves named shelf_lower and shelf_upper. probes/02_geometry.out confirms overall dimensions 0.16 x 0.225 x 0.33 m. All four renders show the requested plain primitive construction.

claims.claim: Collision geometry matches the visible model and preserves the open shelf space.
claims.evidence: probes/02_geometry.out confirms exact visual/collision correspondence for all seven boxes, including their origins, rotations and sizes. renders/front.png, side.png, top.png and iso.png agree with those primitives. readings.json has no collision meshes or extra cavity-filling boxes; the back plate occupies X=-0.070 to -0.062 m and the front at +X remains open.

claims.claim: The lower shelf is accessible from +X with a 5 cm object held from above.
claims.evidence: readings.json shelf_lower approach is [-1,0,0], entering from +X. probes/02_geometry.out reports a 0.170 m wide opening and 0.242 m vertical clearance between shelf surfaces, leaving 0.192 m above a 0.050 m cube. An 0.080 m finger opening plus two 0.020 m fingers fits within that width. At the target centre the cube clears the back plate by 0.037 m and each side by 0.060 m; there is no front crossbar above the lower shelf blocking insertion.

claims.claim: Joint travel, moving-part support and inter-link interference requirements are satisfied as not applicable.
claims.evidence: readings.json joints is empty; asset/model.urdf contains only the base link and no joints, confirmed by probes/02_geometry.out. Both shelves and all structural parts belong to the same fixed rigid body.

claims.claim: Handle grasp and pull requirements are satisfied as not applicable.
claims.evidence: request.md specifies no handles, and readings.json handles is empty, also recorded in probes/02_geometry.out.

claims.claim: A 5 cm, 0.1 kg cube settles and remains supported on each named shelf target inside the side and back boundaries.
claims.evidence: probes/01_place.py drops one cube 0.010 m above each target. probes/01_place.out records unchanged centre positions at 60 and 180 frames: lower (0,0,0.07895) m and upper (0,0,0.32895) m, placing their bottoms within 0.00005 m of the respective 0.054 and 0.304 m shelf tops. Each cube has four support contacts of 0.245 N, totalling approximately its 0.981 N weight. The cube footprints remain inside the shelves with 0.037 m back clearance, 0.060 m side clearance and 0.045 m front margin.

claims.claim: Free-standing rigid-object settling is not applicable to this fixed fixture.
claims.evidence: request.md explicitly requires a fixture loaded fixed on a table; asset/asset.json and readings.json agree on kind=fixture. probes/01_place.out confirms the fixed base stays at the origin with identity rotation while supporting both cubes. No free-body stability claim is made.
